sources: OBJ Arts Identifier (5-star Arts Unit). Skill 3, sk_wpn_funnel_0014 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData; values from SkillPatchTable at the weapon's skill-3 level: hp_up 0.10-0.28, dmg_up 0.08 at level 1 to 0.224 at level 9, duration 15, lv): "Max HP +{hp_up}. When the wielder's combo skill applies Arts Burst or Physical Status, the entire team gains Heat DMG Dealt and Electric DMG Dealt +{dmg_up} for {duration}s. Effects of the same name cannot stack." passiveEventActions abilityEvent 127 (the wielder applies an Arts Burst) and 401 (the wielder applies a Physical Status), each CheckOriginSkillType skillTypeList [6] (combo) → CreateBuffAction buff_wpn_funnel_0014_up on every team member (CharacterTeamFinder), assigning dmg_up, duration and lv.

buff_wpn_funnel_0014_up: attributes 51 (Heat DMG) and 52 (Electric DMG) formulaItem 5 + dmg_up for duration; stackingType 11 with priorityKey lv and maxStackCnt 1, so two wielders' copies are one group and the strongest acts (the loader's stackGroup from gameBuff: batch 3 B2).

Its other effects (Intellect, wpn_sp_attr_phy_spell_mid: Arts Intensity, Max HP + hp_up: cardAttributeModifier) are in the stat panel. toggleBuffs names buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01, which has no BuffData file; buff_wpn_funnel_0014_hp (formulaItem 7) is never created. The CreateBuffActions' finishWithNextSkillIfNotInherited is read as for every other weapon passive (no effect on a passive's buff). Docs: docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0011_seraph.md (E3-E5).

buffs.label: OBJ Arts Identifier: team Heat and Electric DMG (after the wielder's combo bursts or applies a physical status)
buffs.note: Created on the event, so the hit that caused it doesn't have it. A burst lands a second after its infliction on the enemy's clock (A5), so the buff starts then, not at the combo's hit.

triggers.note: abilityEvent 127 + CheckOriginSkillType [6]: an Arts Burst from the wielder's combo skill.

abilityEvent 401 + CheckOriginSkillType [6], without CheckPhysicalInflictionType: any physical status (Lift, Knock Down, Crush, Breach). Whether a Lift or Knock Down that only adds a Vulnerable stack counts is P1 (in-game test 39; engine: no).
